items.name: Beauty of rain [Wan 1.3B]
items.description:
Trigger Word: b3@ut1f0ll_r@in
Model: Wan 2.1 t2i 1.3B
All examples are generated with 1.0 LoRA strength and CFG=6
For inference used Kijai's workflows

Training Details

This is my first attempt to teach lora for Wan 1.3B such a specific movement as painted rain. The dataset included 11 videos from the anime Kotonoha no Niwa (The Garden of Words) with lengths of 16, 30, 60, 72 and 81 frames. Diffusion-pipe was used for training. The training was conducted simultaneously at resolutions 256x456 and 480x854 with num_repeats=1. I used a slightly higher learning rate and as the best model I chose the 54 epoch with lr=8e-05 with LoRA rank of 32.

The version for Wan 14B can be found here https://civitai.com/models/1747192/beauty-of-rain-wan-14b

items.name: David Dubnitskiy — The Warmth of Natural Beauty | LoRA (Krea2 Turbo)
items.description:
David Dubnitskiy — The Warmth of Natural Beauty | LoRA (Krea2 Turbo)

Produced at the initiative and request of, and using a dataset provided by https://civitai.red/user/GeCo — a huge, heartfelt thank you to him for that.

A portrait LoRA trained on the photographic manner of David Dubnitskiy (1977–2024), a world-renowned Ukrainian photographer from Dnipro. The model reproduces his signature "ламповая" (cozy, analog-like) aesthetic: soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, retro-inspired interiors, and a deeply respectful, sensual celebration of natural female beauty without heavy makeup or artificial styling.

Trained and tested on Krea2 Turbo.

About the Artist

David Dubnitskiy (born April 29, 1977, in Dnipro, Ukraine) was a self-taught photographer who began his journey at age 34 and rapidly gained international recognition

focus.ua

. He specialized in art-nude and staged portrait photography, conducting workshops worldwide

www.facebook.com

. He was known for his philosophy that "a woman can be sensual without makeup and in simple clothing"

apostrophe.ua

. Tragically, he passed away in a motorcycle accident, leaving behind a legacy of over 100,000+ followers and millions of views for his harmonious, life-affirming work

focus.ua

.

The Manner

  • Lighting: Soft, diffused natural light (window light, dappled sunlight, golden hour). Avoidance of harsh artificial studio strobes in favor of organic, directional illumination.

  • Skin & Texture: Natural, unretouched skin texture. Celebration of real bodies, soft curves, freckles, and authentic details. No "plastic" smoothing or airbrushing.

  • The Living Eye: Sincere, playful, or intimate gazes. Often a warm half-smile or a direct, trusting look at the viewer.

  • Palette: Warm earthy tones, soft whites, pastel fabrics, natural greens (outdoor/dacha settings), amber, and honey-like warmth.

  • Backgrounds: Cozy retro interiors, sunlit gardens, simple textured walls, or heavily blurred natural environments (rich bokeh).

  • Composition: Medium shots and three-quarter portraits, emphasizing natural posture and graceful curves. Shot equivalence of 50mm and 85mm lenses for intimate framing and shallow depth of field.

  • Mood: Carefree lightness, intimate warmth, tasteful sensuality, nostalgia, and harmonious serenity.

Tested Generation Settings

  • Base model: Krea2 Turbo

  • VAE: qwen_image_vae

  • Text encoder: qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled

  • Steps: 8

  • Sampler: Euler a

  • Schedule type: Bong Tangent

  • CFG scale: 1.0

  • Resolution: 1024×1536 (вертикальный портрет)

  • LoRA weight: 0.85–1.0

  • Negative prompt: cartoon, anime, painting, 3d render, plastic skin, heavy makeup, harsh studio flash, bright white background, deformed, ugly, blurry, low quality, modern neon, oversharpened

Trigger Words

Dubnitskiy style, natural light portrait, art nude aesthetic, staged photography, retro interior, shallow depth of field

Boosters: soft window light, natural skin texture, warm amber tones, playful sincere gaze, pastel dress, cozy dacha atmosphere, 50mm lens bokeh, carefree lightness

Versions

Epoch 20 (current) — full training; stable at weight 0.85–1.0.

Rights & Ethics

David Dubnitskiy was a real, respected artist whose work celebrated natural beauty with dignity. This LoRA is a stylistic study created for educational and non-commercial creative exploration. Generated portraits are original compositions inspired by his aesthetic. Do not use to create misleading, non-consensual, or disrespectful imagery. Honor the artist's legacy by using this tool responsibly.

一种廉价的滤镜效果。

这类模型不太会做，这只是个学习中的产物。

推荐强度1~1.3。

适合写实模型，动漫模型没有测试。简单测试后的效果：为画面进一步添加轮廓。但不明显，附带的将亮度提升或者是为写实增加一点动漫风格。

制作写实图片可以尝试一下，如果质量不好就不要用了，正如我说的，这只是个学习过程的产物，我也仅仅试了三组参数而已。

————

A cheap filter effect.

This type of model is not very good at making, it is just a product of learning.

The specific effect varies depending on the parameters and model.

The structure of the picture consists of a symbiosis of duality - seen this way from 3 components: the frame of the setting and a subject divided into two parts.

1 frame / setting

2 parts of 1 subject (1natural - 1 describable)

  • One side of the subject usually remains natural, whereas the other is characterized by the features described in the prompt. In this case, frame stands metaphorically for the frame of the setting and can be described in a part.

  • If you want to describe 2 sides of a subject within its framework, and you want the parts of a subject to be presented in general divisions, you can describe them as "side", "part" or as "half" as well to highlight differences. This means that detailed differences can be split up from left to right and displayed from top to bottom also.

It is helpful to divide the description into 3 parts, if you only describe 2, the lora will promptly represent the theme in a fussed sybiosis of duality. Since Lora is trained to portray one side of the subject naturally, a simple description/trigger like "shown in its natural beauty" is sufficient here and devotes more detailed descriptions to the other two parts.

Of course, everyone is free to use Lora according to their own ideas :) The information just mentioned is only optional

It is not always a straight division, rather the parts merge into one another

___________________________________________________________________________________________________

I recommend a CFG at 2.5 for detailed, formulated long prompts to describe the symbiosis, for short prompts with an explicit description of the 3 parts CFG at 2 is sufficient mostly.
